chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Faḍālah, from Ḥusayn ibn ʿUthmān, from Ibn Muskān, from al-Ḥalabī, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the urine of horses and mules, and he said: “Wash whatever of it touches you.”

key_terms.أَبْوَالِ: urine; bodily waste discussed in a ruling of ritual purity
key_terms.أَصَابَكَ: touched you or came upon you
key_terms.اِغْسِلْ: wash; an imperative command to cleanse

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام say about washing horse and mule urine?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling from Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام concerning the urine of horses and mules. He instructs that whatever of it touches a person or garment should be washed, indicating a ruling related to ritual purity.
